guide.summary: Overflow production: money units per field, final statuses, deposits, donor-PII care, and writes via mutate.
guide.content:
# Overflow usage

Overflow **production**: live nonprofit giving data, real donors, and real money.

Nonprofit purpose: Grace Church giving and deposits

## Money, units, and status

Overflow does not use one money unit, so read the unit per field:

- Fields named `…InCents` are cents: deposits and their line items and
  totals, refunds, chargebacks, and the authorize body.
- Recurring-gift `amount` is dollars: Overflow's create and update bodies
  say so, and its subscription reads carry the same field.
- Contribution `amount` states no unit in Overflow's schema. Check one known
  gift before reporting totals.
- `status` is per asset type. A gift is final at `PAID_OUT` (cash),
  `CONFIRMED` (manual cash, crypto), `CONTRIBUTION_RECEIVED` or `BILLED`
  (stock), and `CONTRIBUTION_RECEIVED` (DAF). `statusBucket` filters by
  Overflow's coarser PENDING / CONFIRMED / FAILED / CANCELED.
- There is no funds endpoint. A gift reports its campaign and subcampaign;
  `fundId` and `subFundId` appear only in the payment-authorize body.
- Poll for changes with `minimumUpdatedDate`; `minimumInitiatedDate` is
  when the donor gave.

## Reconcile a deposit

`list_deposits` → `get_deposit_summary` for totals → `get_deposit` for the
line items, whose `referenceId` names the contribution, refund, or
chargeback. Contributions also carry their `depositId`.

## Donor data is sensitive

Giving history and donor contact details are personal data. Reduce inside
`execute_code` — aggregate, count, or keep ids — and return names, emails,
phones, or addresses only when the task needs them. Contribution rows carry
only the donor's id and name; `list_donors` includes email but omits phone and
address; `get_donor` is the deliberate full-contact lookup.

## Writes go through `overflow_api_mutate`

Every Overflow write moves money or changes a donor record, so none has a
named tool. Each is one approval-gated `overflow_api_mutate` call with
Overflow's documented body:

- `POST /contributions` charges a saved payment method. Its `amount`
  states no unit; confirm it against a known gift of the same donor before
  charging. `POST /payments/authorize` takes `amountInCents` and
  authorizes a new method (`0` only saves it).
- `POST /contributions/{id}/initiate-refund` (under $1,000 only).
- `POST` / `PATCH` / `DELETE /subscriptions/{donorId}[/{subscriptionId}]`
  creates, changes, or cancels a recurring gift. Its `amount` is dollars,
  not cents: a $50.00 monthly gift is `amount: 50`. Cancel takes a
  `cancellationReason` body.
- `POST /donors`, `PATCH /donors/{id}`.

Resolve every id first — donors, payment methods (`list_payment_methods`),
campaigns, locations — and never guess one. A write that fails with HTTP 5xx
may still have happened: read before retrying.

## Hatches, pages, and limits

- `overflow_api_get` reaches the reads without a named tool: single refunds,
  chargebacks, campaigns, locations, webhooks, and recurring gifts
  (`/subscriptions/{donorId}/{id}`), and Tap devices, groups, and
  destinations (`/tap/devices`, `/tap/groups`, `/tap/destinations`). Paths
  are below `/api/v3`; array filters repeat a `name[]` query pair.
- Lists page by number: pass `page` while `page.hasMore` is true.
  `list_webhook_event_logs` pages by cursor instead.
- Overflow allows 120 requests per minute per API client. This connection
  admits the same per runtime, four at a time, which approximates rather than
  enforces it; a `rate_limited` failure carries the wait.

tools.name: overflow_api_get
tools.description: Call any Overflow v3 GET endpoint and return its untouched body. Prefer a named read; this covers single refunds, chargebacks, campaigns, and Tap devices.

path.description: Path below /api/v3 beginning with '/', e.g. /refunds/<id>. No query string.

query.description: Query parameters as name/value pairs; repeat a name to send several values.

tools.name: overflow_api_mutate
tools.description: Send a JSON POST, PATCH, or DELETE to Overflow v3. Every Overflow write — charges, refunds, recurring gifts, donor edits — goes here, behind approval.

method.description: Mutation method the Overflow endpoint requires.

path.description: Path below /api/v3 beginning with '/', e.g. /refunds/<id>. No query string.

query.description: Query parameters as name/value pairs; repeat a name to send several values.

body.description: JSON body exactly as Overflow documents it. Units differ: subscription `amount` is dollars, /payments/authorize takes `amountInCents`, /contributions `amount` states none. Omit when the endpoint takes none.

result.description: Overflow's untouched response body, or null when it sent none.

tools.name: list_contributions
tools.description: List gifts (cash, stock, crypto, DAF, manual) with status, amount, campaign, deposit, and donor name. Donor contact details stay in get_donor.

minimumUpdatedDate.description: Updated on or after; ISO date or date-time.

maximumUpdatedDate.description: Updated on or before; ISO date or date-time.

minimumInitiatedDate.description: Initiated on or after; ISO date or date-time.

maximumInitiatedDate.description: Initiated on or before; ISO date or date-time.

statusBucket.description: Overflow's coarse status buckets; matches any.

limit.description: Rows per page, up to Overflow's cap of 100. Defaults to 25.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

tools.name: get_contribution
tools.description: Get one contribution by id with its status, amount, campaign, deposit, and donor name. Refunds and chargebacks are separate lists.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

tools.name: list_deposits
tools.description: List deposits (payouts from Overflow to the nonprofit's bank) with status, net amount in cents, arrival date, and reconciliation state.

startDate.description: Arrived on or after; ISO date or date-time.

endDate.description: Arrived on or before; ISO date or date-time.

minimumAmountInCents.description: Net amount at least this, in cents.

maximumAmountInCents.description: Net amount at most this, in cents.

search.description: Overflow's free-text search across deposit fields.

limit.description: Rows per page, up to Overflow's cap of 100. Defaults to 25.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

tools.name: get_deposit
tools.description: Get one deposit with its line items: each payment, refund, chargeback, adjustment, or transfer it settled, in cents. Totals are get_deposit_summary.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

tools.name: get_deposit_summary
tools.description: Get one deposit's totals by kind — contributions, refunds, chargebacks, adjustments — as count, gross, fees, and net in cents.

tools.name: list_refunds
tools.description: List refunds with status, reason, amount, and net in cents, optionally for one contribution. Reads only; issuing a refund is a mutate call.

minimumUpdatedDate.description: Updated on or after; ISO date or date-time.

maximumUpdatedDate.description: Updated on or before; ISO date or date-time.

limit.description: Rows per page, up to Overflow's cap of 100. Defaults to 25.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

tools.name: list_chargebacks
tools.description: List chargebacks (card disputes and ACH returns) with status — pending, won, lost — and amounts in cents, optionally for one contribution.

minimumUpdatedDate.description: Updated on or after; ISO date or date-time.

maximumUpdatedDate.description: Updated on or before; ISO date or date-time.

limit.description: Rows per page, up to Overflow's cap of 100. Defaults to 25.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

tools.name: list_donors
tools.description: List donors with name, email, gift count, and recurring count. Cannot search by name or email; omits phone and address, which get_donor returns.

minimumUpdatedDate.description: Updated on or after; ISO date or date-time.

maximumUpdatedDate.description: Updated on or before; ISO date or date-time.

limit.description: Rows per page, up to Overflow's cap of 100. Defaults to 25.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

tools.name: get_donor
tools.description: Get one donor's full profile: contact details, mailing address, locations, and giving counts. Their gifts are list_contributions rows.

donorId.description: 24-hex id from list_donors or a contribution's donor.id.

tools.name: list_subscriptions
tools.description: List recurring gifts with status, amount, frequency, next payment date, and campaign — for the nonprofit or, given donorId, one donor.

donorId.description: 24-hex id from list_donors; omit for every donor.

minimumUpdatedDate.description: Updated on or after; ISO date or date-time.

maximumUpdatedDate.description: Updated on or before; ISO date or date-time.

limit.description: Rows per page, up to Overflow's cap of 100. Defaults to 25.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

tools.name: list_payment_methods
tools.description: List one donor's saved payment methods (type, last 4, expiry) and their ids. Unpaginated. Never returns account or card numbers.

showExpired.description: Include expired methods. Defaults to false.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: List campaigns or subcampaigns with status, dates, and giving totals. Ids feed the campaignId filters and gift bodies.

isSubcampaign.description: True lists subcampaigns instead. Defaults to false.

parentCampaignId.description: 24-hex id from list_campaigns; lists its subcampaigns.

limit.description: Rows per page, up to Overflow's cap of 100. Defaults to 25.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List the nonprofit's locations (campuses) with names and ids for the locationIds filters. The default location is flagged.

limit.description: Rows per page, up to Overflow's cap of 100. Defaults to 25.

tools.name: list_tap_events
tools.description: List Tap-to-give taps with the device, group, and destination each hit. Taps are engagement, not gifts; giving is list_contributions.

startDate.description: On or after; ISO date or date-time.

endDate.description: On or before; ISO date or date-time.

items.description: Id from a tap event's groupId.

groupIds.description: Ids from a tap event's groupId; matches any.

items.description: Id from a tap event's destinationId.

destinationIds.description: Ids from a tap event's destinationId; matches any.

items.description: Id from a tap event's deviceId.

deviceIds.description: Ids from a tap event's deviceId; matches any.

limit.description: Rows per page, up to Overflow's cap of 100. Defaults to 25.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

tools.name: list_webhooks
tools.description: List the nonprofit's webhook subscriptions with destination URL, enabled events, and status. Delivery history is list_webhook_event_logs.

limit.description: Rows per page, up to Overflow's cap of 100. Defaults to 25.

tools.name: list_webhook_event_logs
tools.description: List delivery attempts for one webhook with status, response code, and error. Omits event payloads unless raw. Pages by cursor, not page.

webhookEventName.description: Event name, e.g. contribution.approved or donor.updated.

cursor.description: This tool pages by cursor: pass nextCursor back unchanged.

limit.description: Attempts per page, up to Overflow's cap of 50 for this endpoint. Defaults to 25.

raw.description: Return Overflow's untouched rows instead of the lean projection.

nextCursor.description: Present only when more attempts exist; no page object.
